title: Manual evidence archive manifest -- the ONLY trusted source of an evidence_hash convert-manual-results-evidence will ever accept
description: Produced by manual_evidence_archiver.py (python -m pcbf_calculator archive-manual-results-evidence), the separate evidence-preservation tool that actually fetches, archives, and hashes a cited match-report page. Every field here is tool-generated at retrieval time -- NEVER copied from an LLM's own evidence-collection output, which is exactly the untrusted input this manifest exists to check against. Append-only: entries are added, never edited or removed, by that tool alone.

requested_url.description: The exact URL an evidence-collection source cited -- the join key convert-manual-results-evidence looks sources up by.

final_url.description: The URL actually retrieved after following any redirects -- may differ from requested_url.

retrieved_at_utc.description: Tool-generated at fetch time -- never taken from the evidence-collection artifact's own (LLM-supplied) retrieved_at_utc.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archived bytes at archive_path, computed by the archiving tool at retrieval time. convert-manual-results-evidence independently RECOMPUTES this from the file on disk and refuses the entry if they disagree -- this field is never trusted on its own.

archive_path.description: Path (relative to the manifest's own directory, i.e. under ledger_data/manual_evidence/) to the immutable, archived response bytes this entry describes.
